name: blacktop-brawl
description: Blacktop Brawl: 16-bit motorcycle combat racing in the browser. TypeScript + Vite + Canvas2D + WebAudio.

scripts.assets:all: tsx scripts/generate-images.ts && tsx scripts/generate-audio.ts && tsx scripts/build-manifest.ts
scripts.assets:local: tsx scripts/derive-frames.ts && tsx scripts/synth-sfx.ts && tsx scripts/make-icons.ts && tsx scripts/build-manifest.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../release.zip && zip -qr ../release.zip . && cd .. && echo "release.zip ready"
